findings.title: Renamed/relocated public functions without updating call sites or tests
findings.body: This refactor renames `mark_failed_threshold` -> `try_incident_threshold` (moved to `monitors/logic/incidents.py`) and `create_issue_platform_occurrence` -> `create_incident_occurrence` (moved to `monitors/logic/incident_occurrence.py`), along with moving helpers like `get_failure_reason`, `get_monitor_environment_context`, `HUMAN_FAILURE_STATUS_MAP`, `SINGULAR_HUMAN_FAILURE_MAP`, and `SimpleCheckIn` out of `mark_failed.py`. The PR only touches 4 files and no test files are included in the change set. Any existing tests or other modules that import these symbols directly from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed` (a common pattern for unit-testing internal helpers like `get_failure_reason` or `create_issue_platform_occurrence`) will now fail with ImportError since those names no longer exist in that module. This should be verified/fixed by updating all references to the new module paths and names.
